policy.content_rule: Only short, reviewed prompts distilled or translated from the pinned, permissively licensed sources below are included. Long upstream answers are not redistributed.
policy.runtime_rule: The application reads static reviewed JSON. It does not crawl, scrape, or fetch question content at runtime.
